= footnote-stages(1)
:doctype: manpage

:manmanual: Footnote tests
:mansource: acdc
:name: Early
:fn-note: footnote:attribute[Attribute *body* {name}.]

== Name

footnote-stages - apply substitutions around footnotes

== Description

[source,subs="specialcharacters,attributes,macros,quotes,replacements"]
----
Early footnote:early[Early {name} *literal* (C).] {fn-note}
----

[source,subs="specialcharacters,macros,attributes,quotes,replacements"]
----
Late footnote:late[Late {name} *literal* (C).] {fn-note}
----

:name: Changed

[source,subs="specialcharacters,attributes,macros,quotes,replacements"]
----
Changed early footnote:early[Early {name} *literal* (C).]
----

[source,subs="specialcharacters,macros,attributes,quotes,replacements"]
----
Same captured late footnote:late[Late {name} *literal* (C).]
----

[source,subs="specialcharacters,quotes,replacements,macros"]
----
Quotes footnote:[(C). *Bold*]
----

After footnote:[Last note.]
